title: Andrii Co. Notary & Apostille Assistant
description: Book a Washington notary or apostille appointment, get a quote, and track it, via AI assistant.
summary: Book a Washington notary or apostille appointment, get a quote, and track it, via AI assistant.
offersHint: Book a Washington notary or apostille appointment, get a quote, and track it, via AI assistant. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://andrii.net/mcp

toolsPreview.name: book_appointment
toolsPreview.description: Book a notary/apostille appointment for the signed-in customer, bound to their account. Call search_availability first and pass a slot's startUnix as scheduledAt (omit for a 'call me to schedule' request). Requires sign-in.

toolsPreview.name: cancel_booking
toolsPreview.description: Cancel one of the signed-in customer's OWN Pending or Scheduled bookings. Requires sign-in.

toolsPreview.name: check_request_status
toolsPreview.description: Check the current status of a previously submitted request by its reference id — whether the notary confirmed/scheduled it (and for when, Pacific time), rescheduled, cancelled, or merged it with another request. No sign-in needed. Call this whenever the customer asks about their request's status or whether anything changed since it was submitted.

toolsPreview.name: check_service_area
toolsPreview.description: Check whether an address is inside Andrii Co.'s Washington service area, and get its resolved location + whether it's precise enough to book. Read-only; no booking.

toolsPreview.name: get_apostille_requirements
toolsPreview.description: Check whether a document qualifies for an apostille and how — certified vital records can be apostilled as-is (mail-in), a private document (diploma/POA) needs a notarization first, federal documents go to the US Department of State. Includes the honest do-it-yourself path AND our offer. Pure, no side effects.

toolsPreview.name: get_price_quote
toolsPreview.description: Get a server-authoritative USD price estimate (before shipping). Pure calculation, no side effects.

toolsPreview.name: get_services
toolsPreview.description: The full service catalog (Washington State notary & apostille) with prices and the accepted payment options. Optional — the server instructions already summarize the flow; call this when the customer asks about services or payment methods.

toolsPreview.name: get_turnaround_estimate
toolsPreview.description: Estimate typical completion + shipping timing for a service (apostille processing days, mail-in and delivery legs). Ranges, not guarantees; no side effects. For an exact appointment time use search_availability.

toolsPreview.name: my_bookings
toolsPreview.description: List the signed-in customer's OWN notary/apostille bookings (most recent first). Requires sign-in.

toolsPreview.name: request_apostille
toolsPreview.description: Submit a mail-in apostille request (a lead). For already-certified Washington public records that need NO notarization (birth/marriage/death certificates). The notary follows up with where to mail the documents and a quote; nothing is charged until approved. Requires a name and either an email or a phone.

toolsPreview.name: request_booking
toolsPreview.description: Submit a booking request (a lead — NOT a confirmed appointment; the notary follows up to confirm). Requires the customer's FULL LEGAL NAME and an email or phone (collect both). Pass a chosen slot's startUnix as desired_time_unix (from search_availability). To modify/extend an existing request, pass existing_reference instead of creating a duplicate.

toolsPreview.name: request_price_match
toolsPreview.description: Ask us to consider matching a comparable licensed notary's WRITTEN quote. This is a request the notary reviews — it never sets a price automatically. We reply with our own comparable quote and a match decision within one business day. Requires a name and either an email or a phone.

toolsPreview.name: reschedule_booking
toolsPreview.description: Reschedule one of the signed-in customer's OWN bookings to a new slot's startUnix (strict — the new time must be genuinely available). Requires sign-in.

toolsPreview.name: search_availability
toolsPreview.description: Find open notary/apostille appointment slots — this also validates the service area for the given address. Returns the resolved location, up to 7 `recommended` slots (each with `startUnix`), and per-day booking `windows`: the k-th bookable start is `startUnixFrom + k*stepSec` for k < `startCount`. Pass the chosen start's Unix seconds to request_booking as desired_time_unix. "mobile" needs an address; "office"/"apostille" use our office.
